images.filename: I didn't camp in the national park campground near Sol Duc (29715069926).jpg
images.caption:
It was full anyway and expensive.  I rode back down to Crescent Lake.  Also bear warning signs in Sol Duc area.  I didn't see the warning signs down by Crescent Lake.  

In summer, bears tend to go to higher elevations, I think.  The spring is quite a bit higher than the lake.  It was just about all down hill back to the lake.

images.caption:
Multiple articles in issue discuss Seattle's tercentenary celebration of Shakespeare and Shakespearian history. Page 3 article "Where are They?" discusses suffrage in Seattle. Page 4 article "Broadway's Invitation" discusses Broadway High School's open house.
